== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34710) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Veasey DS Verge.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 27 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 27 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>abc58ffba0cc43277b74b1ddcfa1bd1ab1572d5e922e768c3e56e18820201a74</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 2x [[Darth Vader, Emperor's Enforcer (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>208_30^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (ALT)]]: XML <nowiki>200_110^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Death Star (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>216_7^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
